meta.name: talking-head-recut
meta.description: Package an existing talking-head / interview / podcast video with timed, designed GRAPHIC OVERLAY cards — kinetic titles, lower-thirds, data callouts, quotes, side panels, picture-in-picture — synced to the transcript, on a 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5 canvas of your choice; the clip plays untouched underneath. Trigger on "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", "package / dress up my video". Not plain subtitles (/embedded-captions). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 给口播、访谈或播客视频叠上跟随字幕出现的动态图形卡
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果手上有一段口播或访谈素材,想让它看起来更精致、信息更清楚
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you have a talking-head or interview clip and want it to look sharper and clearer

howto.what: 给已有的口播、访谈或播客视频叠加与转写对齐的图形卡片(标题、下三分之一、数据标注等),原视频画面不变,渲染为 MP4;画布可选 16:9 / 9:16 / 4:5。
howto.when: 当你提到 “graphic overlays”、“on-screen graphics” 等关键词,或要求给已有视频做图形包装时触发。纯字幕不算(那走 embedded-captions),意图不明先转 /hyperframes。

say.text: 帮我给这段口播视频加图形卡片,做成 9:16 竖版
say.note: 先本地转写,再逐卡设计并渲染

say.text: 把这条访谈视频包装一下,加下三分之一和引言卡
这段播客视频按字幕时间点铺图形层,原画面保留

howto.what_en: Overlays timed, designed graphic cards (titles, lower-thirds, data callouts) onto an existing talking-head, interview, or podcast video, synced to the transcript. The clip plays untouched; output is an MP4 on a 16:9, 9:16, or 4:5 canvas.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "graphic overlays", "on-screen graphics", or ask to package an existing video. Plain subtitles go to embedded-captions; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Add graphic cards to this talking-head video, 9:16 portrait
say_en.note: Transcribes locally, then designs and renders

say_en.text: Package this interview with lower-thirds and quote cards
say_en.note: Cards are timed to the transcript

say_en.text: Lay graphic overlays over this podcast at the subtitle timings
